description: The Badass tiers: when they appear (by the PLAYER's level), how strong they are and how their guaranteed drop is shifted. Every number is a placeholder (source 'design') until the Borderlands 2 badass survey (Check-BL2-Badass.bat) gives BL2's own; the rule: BL2 file values replace static values. See docs/badass-roadmap.md.

columns.player_level_gate: the player's level from which this tier can appear
columns.percent: chance (percent) for an eligible enemy at the gate level
columns.per_level: percent more for every player level above the gate
columns.max_percent: the chance never goes above this
columns.max_near: at most this many of the tier alive within the pump's reach (6000 units); the badass row's number counts every tier
columns.health_mult: max health times this (a tracked temporary Health bonus)
columns.damage_mult: damage times this (AttackDamageMult for melee/arrows, launch power for plugin-fired bullets)
columns.rarity_shift: the drop's rarity weights move up this many rarities
columns.min_rarity: the guaranteed drop is at least this rarity (1 common ... 6 e-tech)
columns.bl2_object: the Borderlands 2 object the numbers come from ('-' when none yet)

rows.note: from level 1 (the user's choice); 3 percent then +0.5 a level
bosses and dragons are at least this tier
a boss is Ultimate half the time from player level 25
